item.title: Burn bans across Central Texas that are in effect
item.description: This week, multiple counties across the Central Texas region are declaring a burn ban, meaning no outdoor burning is allowed for public safety reasons. Here are the current counties under burn bans.

item.title: Mexia basketball's Kelan Collins sets three new program records
item.description: Mexia Blackcats basketball senior Kelan Collins has had quite the season, setting three new program records including single game scoring, single season scoring and career scoring.

item.title: FIVE in a row: La Vega girls basketball crowned district champions
item.description: La Vega girls basketball defeats Lorena on the road to out right win the district title. This marks the fifth season in a row the Pirates have been crowned district champions
